title: Mission-Aware Satellite Cyber Response and Trusted Recovery — Study 2 Phase-6 Source Evidence
publication_date_instruction: Use the actual Zenodo publication date when the authenticated external record is published; do not predeclare or backdate it in this repository handoff.
description: Exact responsible-release-reviewed Phase-6 source-evidence package for Study 2 (S2-AEATR-001) of the Mission-Aware Satellite Cyber Response and Trusted Recovery research program. The frozen package contains 3,872 VALID observations, 0 INVALID attempts, and 85 frozen cells. It is released for reproducibility and independent verification of the separately frozen Study-2 statistical results. The evidence uses controlled defensive software simulation/modeling and contains no operational spacecraft data, RF targeting, real credentials, proprietary mission telemetry, or human-subject data. This dataset is distinct from the Study-1 Zenodo record and must receive its own DOI.
